name: security-hub-vscode
description: Shows the findings of Security Testing Hub (SQL injection, XSS, secrets, access control, Supabase / Firebase rules...) in the Problems panel, with a score and a ready-to-paste fix prompt for your AI assistant.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Scanning runs the security-hub command in the workspace folder; a project you do not trust could provide its own copy of it.

commands.title: Security Hub: Copy the fix prompt for this finding

securityHub.command.markdownDescription: The command that runs the scanner (`scan <folder> --format json --prompts` is appended). Machine-wide on purpose: a workspace cannot change it, so a project cannot make the extension run something else. Use `security-hub` if you installed it globally, or pin a version such as `npx --yes security-hub@0.6.0`.

securityHub.scanOnSave.description: Scan again whenever a JavaScript or TypeScript file is saved (the whole project is scanned, so a call into another file is still followed).

securityHub.minSeverity.description: Show only findings at or above this severity.
